title: Signal Catalog Schema
description: JSON Schema for aponyx signal catalog after legacy compatibility removal. Enforces indicator + transformation composition pattern.

name.description: Unique signal identifier (lowercase with underscores). Example: 'cdx_etf_basis'

description.description: Human-readable explanation of signal purpose and economic intuition

indicator_dependencies.description: List of indicator names required for this signal. All indicators must exist in indicator_catalog.json and be enabled.

transformations.description: List of transformation names to apply sequentially. All transformations must exist in transformation_catalog.json and be enabled.

composition_logic.description: Optional Python expression for combining multiple indicators. Variable names must match indicator_dependencies entries. Example: 'cdx_spread / etf_spread'

enabled.description: Whether signal should be included in batch computation

sign_multiplier.description: Multiplier to apply for sign convention alignment. Use -1 to invert signal direction, 1 for no change.

examples.name: cdx_etf_basis
examples.description: Flow-driven mispricing signal from CDX-ETF basis divergence

examples.name: cdx_vix_gap
examples.description: Cross-asset risk sentiment divergence between credit and equity volatility

examples.name: spread_momentum
examples.description: Short-term volatility-adjusted momentum in CDX spreads

examples.name: relative_value_signal
examples.description: Relative value between CDX IG and HY indices
